description: Show one asset in full: type, prompt, tags, base image, and every frame (animations, 8-way rotations, edits, layers) with its id, name, facings and image keys. Use it after list_assets or a generation, before any tool that takes a frame id (frameIndex, items, frameId) or an image key (referenceFile, end_frame); keys download at full size from https://cdn.voidless.dev/<key>, or as a data URI via get_image_data. Free and read-only. Also returns the world height and each frame's sprite_scale: size the asset in a game from these, never by eye.

frameId.description: Show only this frame, with every image key (long clips otherwise list just their first and last). Omit for the whole asset

id.description: Asset ID (from list_assets / get_asset or a previous result)

preview.description: Include the base image (or the frame's still) inline (default true). false = text only

name: get_asset
